notes: F34 bounded Quality runner fix stacked on F33 PR #1243 / F32 #1238 / F31 #1236. The preview login entrypoint legitimately redirects to the canonical Workforce login, but the old Product Owner Playwright proof still expects a legacy template-specific form. This unit validates exact workforce return-target identity, real authentication, role/MFA enforcement and actual candidate presentation rather than bypassing or changing any auth authority. Missing separate PO proof reconciliation is tracked as distinct subsequent dependency. No main merge, production, Vercel or Supabase mutation.
